## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: After a KV patch and one token-manager refresh, a long-running worker...

The system SHALL ensure that after a KV patch and one token-manager refresh, a long-running worker process uses the new Substack cookie without restart, proven by an integration test that swaps the cache.

#### Scenario: After a KV patch and one token-manager refresh, a long-running worker...

WHEN `introduce-live-credential-provider-for-rotating-secrets` is implemented
THEN After a KV patch and one token-manager refresh, a long-running worker process uses the new Substack cookie without restart, proven by an integration test that swaps the cache.

### Requirement: src/ingestion/substack.py no longer references...

The system SHALL ensure that src/ingestion/substack.py no longer references settings.substack_session_cookie directly.

#### Scenario: src/ingestion/substack.py no longer references...

WHEN `introduce-live-credential-provider-for-rotating-secrets` is implemented
THEN src/ingestion/substack.py no longer references settings.substack_session_cookie directly.

### Requirement: The provider exposes saved_at and last_verified_at for the substack.sid,...

The system SHALL ensure that the provider exposes saved_at and last_verified_at for the substack.sid, x.auth_token, and x.ct0 credentials.

#### Scenario: The provider exposes saved_at and last_verified_at for the substack.sid,...

WHEN `introduce-live-credential-provider-for-rotating-secrets` is implemented
THEN The provider exposes saved_at and last_verified_at for the substack.sid, x.auth_token, and x.ct0 credentials.

### Requirement: No credential value appears in log output in any provider test

The system SHALL ensure that no credential value appears in log output in any provider test.

#### Scenario: No credential value appears in log output in any provider test

WHEN `introduce-live-credential-provider-for-rotating-secrets` is implemented
THEN No credential value appears in log output in any provider test.
